answer: The ikat shed holds dyed threads in bundles, patterns knotted along each skein. Proof of ikat-maker via tie-dyed thread tally — a thread the ikat-maker ties only after 31 threads hold their dye without one bleeding at the knot, each tied by the ikat-maker herself. haven ties the resist knots tight and checks the pattern. fable dips the skein in the indigo vat and lifts it out dripping blue. reef unties the knots once the dye sets and hangs them to dry. Thirty-one threads must hold their dye without one bleeding at the knot, and the next still stains where the knot was tied loose.
